data.body: REVISION_CYCLE_2 (cycle 2 plan review feedback): Add explicit gating tests — (a) test_outbound_update_with_status_field_gating_off_drops_status — Given DSO_RECONCILER_STATUS_GATING=0 + Mutation with status field; When applier dispatches; Then client.update_issue called WITHOUT status kwarg AND StatusMappingError NOT raised (silent drop). (b) test_outbound_update_with_status_field_gating_on_raises — Given DSO_RECONCILER_STATUS_GATING=1 + Mutation with status field; When applier dispatches; Then StatusMappingError raised with zero side-effects. (c) test_status_mapping_error_raised_for_unmapped_status — Given Mutation.status value with no entry in status map; When applier dispatches; Then StatusMappingError raised. These three tests lock gating toggle semantics.
